when_to_use: riff-driven jazz-funk/fusion vamp, tight backbeat, builds and breakdowns, urgency->release arc, 96-124 BPM

defaults.feel: tight 16th funk, hard backbeat, locked to the riff

signature_moves: static vamp: one dominant/sus chord held while bass+drums drive the riff
modal interchange stab: Em9 -> Ebmaj7#11 -> Em9
sus-to-dom release: Gsus13 -> G13 at the section arrival
quartal upper-structure over a pedal bass
cadence_options: vamp turnaround: Em9 -> A13 -> back to the riff
breakdown then release: strip to bass riff, then full band hits the downbeat together
no functional cadence - release is dynamic, not harmonic
avoid: letting harmony wander - harmony is subservient to groove
a laid-back drag - this pocket is on the grid

hook_archetypes.name: unison-riff
hook_archetypes.rhythm: a syncopated 16th riff hit by bass and lead or keys in unison or octaves
hook_archetypes.contour: angular gesture around root and b7, snapping to root on beat 1
hook_archetypes.first_appears: Intro, bass alone, then band joins in unison

hook_archetypes.name: stab-hook
hook_archetypes.rhythm: a full-band offbeat accent that punctuates the vamp
hook_archetypes.contour: upper-structure chord hit as a splash of color
hook_archetypes.first_appears: first build, marking the section change

urgency.note_lengths: short, driving, riff-locked with little space
urgency.contour: angular and insistent around root and b7
urgency.placement: on the grid, forward and tight

build.contour: reach higher each pass over the static vamp

peak.note_lengths: held high notes over the fullest vamp

release.note_lengths: space returns after the breakdown and hit
release.contour: resolve down to root and let riff settle
release.placement: on the grid with reduced push

drum_skeleton.low_energy: tight kick locked to bass riff, hard snare on 2 and 4 on grid, steady 16th hats
drum_skeleton.mid_energy: busier kick syncopation doubling riff, ghost snares between backbeats, hat openings on accents
drum_skeleton.high_energy: full 16th drive, fills and large ensemble hits, followed by breakdown and downbeat re-entry

arrangement_defaults.layout_rules: bass states riff first; drums lock in; layers build over the vamp; breakdown strips to bass riff; full band re-enters on a downbeat hit; solo peak remains riff-centered; final vamp ends with an abrupt ensemble stop

anti_boredom_rules: the vamp must build and break down
include at least one bass-riff breakdown followed by full-band release
riff returns varied by register, layering, or upper-structure stab
velocity is never flat across a voice within a bar
use at least one signature harmonic stab without letting harmony overtake groove

bass_behavior.role: primary unison riff and harmonic anchor
bass_behavior.rhythmic_relationship: tightly doubles kick and selected lead attacks
bass_behavior.density: continuous syncopated riff with breakdown exposure

groove_intent.hihat: steady straight sixteenths with accent openings
groove_intent.ensemble_relationship: bass, drums, and lead converge on unison riffs and release hits

distinguishing_traits: tight on-grid funk instead of laid-back push-pull
dynamic breakdown and abrupt full-band release define the arc

blockers: engine belum punya profil groove 'fusion-tight' di GROOVE_LIBRARY
engine belum punya vibe preset untuk gaya ini di VIBE_PRESETS
